meta.name: remote-collection
meta.description: Configure and troubleshoot CCAM Remote Data Sources that collect Claude Code and Codex history over SSH. Use when adding, editing, testing, syncing, or removing a remote machine, verifying provider paths, or deciding whether to retain or purge imported sessions.

copy.tagline: 配置并排查远程数据源,同步与管理编码会话历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在多台机器上编程并希望集中管理 AI 编码会话记录
copy.tagline_en: Configure remote data sources to collect and manage coding history over SSH.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code on several machines and want to consolidate your AI coding session history.

howto.what: 这个技能用来配置和排查 CCAM 的远程数据源:通过 SSH 从远程机器收集 Claude Code 和 Codex 的使用历史。装上后,你可以添加、编辑、测试、同步或删除远程数据源,并决定导入的历史数据是保留还是清除。
howto.when: 当你说要添加、编辑或删除远程数据源,或要测试、同步远程机器上的历史数据时触发。

say.text: 把主机 myhost 加为远程数据源
say.note: 会读取 SSH 配置并添加来源

say.text: 测试远程数据源 7 号
say.note: 会先跑测试再让你同步

say.text: 删除远程数据源 demo,并清除历史数据
say.note: 删除前会说明数据是否保留

howto.what_en: This skill configures and troubleshoots CCAM remote data sources, collecting Claude Code and Codex history over SSH. After installing it, you can add, edit, test, sync, or remove remote data sources and choose whether to keep or purge imported sessions.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to add, edit, or remove a remote data source, or to test or sync history collected from a remote machine.

say_en.text: Add host myhost as a remote data source.
say_en.note: Reads your SSH config and adds the source.

say_en.text: Remove remote source demo and purge history.
say_en.note: Clarifies whether data will be kept or deleted.
